entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 2
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ الْإِمَامُ الْعَالِمُ الأَوْحَدُ الصَّدْرُ الْكَبِيرُ تَاجُ الدِّينِ أَبُو الْيَمَنِ زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْكِنْدِيُّ ، أَبْقَاهُ اللَّهُ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الْمُقْرِئُ ، أنبا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زِينَةَ ، أَنَبا أَبُو الْفَتْحِ هِلالُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْحَفَّارُ ، قَالَ: قَرَأْتُ عَلَى أَبِي الْفَضْلِ عِيسَى بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ الْمُتَوَكِّلِ عَلَى اللَّهِ ، قَالَ: أنبا
entries.matn_ar: أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُفَيْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ ، ثنا أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ بْنِ قُتَيْبَةَ الأَصْبَهَانِيُّ ، ثنا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ ، ثنا الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ‌ ‌«مَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ ثَلاثًا مِنْ غَيْرِ ضَرُورَةٍ كُتِبَ مُنَافِقًا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ لا يَمْحُو أَوْ لا يُبَدَّلُ»
entries.isnad_en: The shaykh, imam, scholar, the unique one (al-awhad), the great chief (al-sadr al-kabir), Taj al-Din Abu l-Yumn Zayd b. al-Hasan b. Zayd al-Kindi — may God preserve him — informed us, saying: the shaykh Abu Muhammad 'Abd Allah b. 'Ali b. Ahmad al-Muqri' informed us; Abu 'Ali al-Hasan b. Muhammad b. al-Qasim b. 'Abd Allah b. Zina informed us; Abu l-Fath Hilal b. Muhammad b. Ja'far al-Haffar informed us, saying: I recited to Abu l-Fadl 'Isa b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil 'ala Allah, who said: Abu 'Abd Allah al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. Muhammad b. 'Ufayr b. Muhammad b. Sahl b. Abi Hathma al-Ansari informed us; Abu Muhammad al-Hajjaj b. Yusuf b. Qutayba al-Asbahani narrated to us; Bishr b. al-Husayn narrated to us; al-Zubayr b. 'Adi narrated to us, from Anas b. Malik al-Ansari, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever leaves the Friday prayer three times without necessity is recorded as a hypocrite in the Book of God, which neither erases nor is altered.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 3
entries.matn_ar: ‌«مَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ تَهَاوُنًا بِهَا طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And by his chain of transmission, he said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever leaves the Friday prayer out of negligence, God sets a seal upon his heart.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 4
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِإِسْنَادِهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ أَتَانِي جِبْرِيلُ بِمِرْآةٍ فِيهَا نُكْتَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ ، فَقُلْتُ: مَا هَذِهِ يَا جِبْرِيلُ؟ قَالَ: هَذِهِ الْجُمُعَةُ فُضِّلْتُ بِهَا أَنْتَ وَقَوْمُكَ ، وَاسْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ يَوْمُ الْمَزِيدِ ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: فَمَا هَذِهِ النُّكْتَةُ؟ قَالَ: تَقُومُ فِيهَا السَّاعَةُ ، قُلْتُ: فَمَا يَوْمُ الْمَزِيدِ؟ قَالَ: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ تبارك وتعالى اتَّخَذَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَادِيًا أَفْيَحَ فِيهِ كُثُبٌ مِنْ مِسْكٍ ، فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ نَزَلَ الرَّبُّ تبارك وتعالى ، وَحَفَّ مَجْلِسَهُ بِمَنَابِرَ مِنْ نُورٍ ، فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّونَ ، وَحُفَّتْ تِلْكَ الْمَنَابِرُ بِمَنَابِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ مُكَّلَلَةٍ بِالْيَاقُوتِ وَالزَّبَرْجَدِ ، فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهَا الصِّدِّيقُونَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ ، وَنَزَلَ أَهْلُ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ ، فَكَانُوا عَلَى ذَلِكَ ، فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ: أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ قَدْ صَدَقْتُكُمْ وَعْدِى ، فَاسْأَلُونِي أُعْطِكُمْ. فَيَقُولُونَ: نَسْأَلُكَ رِضْوَانَكَ. فَيَقُولُ: قَدْ رَضِيتُ عَنْكُمْ وَلَدَيَّ مَزِيدٌ. وَلا يَوْمَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: And by his chain of transmission, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Jibril came to me with a mirror in which there was a black spot. I said: What is this, O Jibril? He said: This is Friday; you and your people have been favored with it, and its name with your Lord is the Day of Increase (yawm al-mazid). He said: I said: And what is this spot? He said: The Hour will be established on it. I said: And what is the Day of Increase? He said: Your Lord, Blessed and Exalted, has made in Paradise a spacious valley in which are hills of musk; and when it is the day of Friday, the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, descends, and surrounds His assembly with pulpits of light, and the prophets sit upon them; and those pulpits are surrounded by pulpits of gold, crowned with rubies and chrysolite, and the truthful (siddiqun) and the martyrs sit upon them; and the people of the Gardens of Eden descend. They remain so, and God says: I am your Lord; I have been true to My promise to you; so ask Me and I shall give you. They say: We ask You for Your good pleasure (ridwan). He says: I am pleased with you, and with Me there is more. And there is no day more beloved to them than the day of Friday.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 5
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ‌ ‌ أَغْبَطَ النَّاسِ عِنْدِي لَرَجُلٌ ذُو حَظٍّ مِنْ صَلاةٍ غَامِضٌ فِي النَّاسِ ، لا يُشَارُ إِلَيْهِ بِالأَصَابِعِ، وَيَمُوتُ إِذَا مَاتَ قَلِيلَ الْمِيرَاثِ وَالْبَوَاكِي، فَذَلِكَ صِفَةُ الْمُؤْمِنِ»
entries.isnad_en: And by it, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The most enviable of people in my view is a man who has a share of prayer, obscure among people, not pointed out with fingers, who, when he dies, dies leaving little inheritance and few mourners; that is the description of the believer.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 6
entries.matn_ar: أُهْدِيَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَيْرٌ مَشْوِيٌّ ، فَلَمَّا وُضِعَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ قَالَ: ‌ ‌«اللَّهُمَّ ائْتِنِي بِأَحَبِّ خَلْقِكَ إِلَيْكَ يَأْكُلُ مَعِيَ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ» . قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ رَجُلا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ، قَالَ: فَجَاءَ عَلِيٌّ عليه السلام ، فَقَرَعَ الْبَابَ قَرْعًا خَفِيًّا ، فَقُلْتُ: مَنْ هَذَا؟ قَالَ: عَلِيٌّ. فَقُلْتُ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى حَاجَةٍ ، فَانْصَرَفَ ، قَالَ: فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ الثَّانِيَةَ: «اللَّهُمَّ ائْتِنِي بِأَحَبِّ خَلْقِكَ إِلَيْكَ يَأْكُلُ مَعِيَ مِنْ هَذَا الطَّيْرِ» . فَقُلْتُ: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ رَجُلا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ، قَالَ: فَجَاءَ عَلِيٌّ ، فَقَرَعَ الْبَابَ ، فَقُلْتُ: أَلَمْ أُخْبِرْكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى حَاجَةٍ ، انْصَرَفَ ، فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ الثَّالِثَةُ: «اللَّهُمَّ ائْتِنِي بِأَحَبِّ خَلْقِكَ إِلَيْكَ يَأْكُلُ مَعِيَ مِنْ هَذَا الطَّيْرِ» . قَالَ: فَجَاءَ عَلِيٌّ فَضَرَبَ الْبَابَ ضَرْبًا شَدِيدًا ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «افْتَحْ افْتَحْ افْتَحْ» . قَالَ: فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ وَالِ ، اللَّهُمُّ وَالِ ، اللَّهُمَّ وَالِ» . فَجَلَسَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْكُلُ مَعَهُ الطَّيْرَ
entries.matn_en: A roasted bird was given as a gift to the Messenger of God ﷺ. When it was placed before him he said: “O God, bring me the one most beloved of Your creation to You to eat with me of the bird.” He said: I said to myself: O God, make him a man of the Ansar. He said: Then 'Ali ﵇ came and knocked at the door softly. I said: Who is this? He said: 'Ali. I said: The Messenger of God ﷺ is occupied with something; so he left. He said: I returned to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he was saying for the second time: “O God, bring me the one most beloved of Your creation to You to eat with me of this bird.” I said: O God, make him a man of the Ansar. He said: Then 'Ali came and knocked at the door. I said: Did I not tell you that the Messenger of God ﷺ is occupied? Leave. I returned to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he was saying for the third time: “O God, bring me the one most beloved of Your creation to You to eat with me of this bird.” He said: Then 'Ali came and struck the door violently, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Open, open, open!” He said: When the Messenger of God ﷺ looked at him, he said: “O God, befriend [him]; O God, befriend [him]; O God, befriend [him].” So he sat with the Messenger of God ﷺ, eating the bird with him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 7
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: ‌
entries.matn_ar: ‌«تَسَحَّرُوا؛ فَإِنَّ فِي السَّحُورِ بَرَكَةً»
entries.isnad_en: And by it, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Eat the predawn meal (suhur), for in the predawn meal there is blessing.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 8
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ‌
entries.matn_ar: ‌«مَنْ قَتَلَ عَبْدَهُ قَتَلْنَاهُ ، وَمَنْ جَدَعَ عَبْدَهُ جَدَعْنَاهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And by it he said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever kills his slave, we shall kill him; and whoever mutilates his slave, we shall mutilate him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 9
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: ‌
entries.matn_ar: ‌«مَنْ حَوَّلَ خَاتَمَهُ أَوْ عِمَامَتَهُ أَوْ عَلَّقَ خَيْطًا فِي إِصْبَعِهِ لِيُذَكِّرَهُ حَاجَتَهُ فَقَدْ أَشْرَكَ بِاللَّهِ ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ يُذَكِّرُ الْحَاجَاتِ»
entries.isnad_en: And by it, that the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever shifts his ring or his turban, or ties a thread on his finger to remind him of his need, has associated partners with God; it is God alone who brings needs to mind.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 10
entries.matn_ar: أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، كَانَ‌ ‌ إِذَا رَأَى فِي أَهْلِهِ مُنْكَرًا ، قَالَ: «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ» . وَإِذَا رَأَى مَا يُحِبُّ ، قَالَ: «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الْمُنْعِمِ الْمُتَفَضِّلِ، اللَّهُمَّ بِنِعْمَتِكَ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ»
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Anas, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ, when he saw something disliked among his family, would say: “Praise be to God in every circumstance.” And when he saw what he loved, he would say: “Praise be to God, the Bestower of favor, the Munificent; O God, by Your favor righteous deeds are completed.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 11
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْرُ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ‌ ‌ إِذَا قُدِّمَ إِلَيْهِ الطَّعَامُ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تُعْطِينَا ، سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ مَا أَعْظَمَ مَا تُعَافِينَا ، سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ مَا أَحْسَنَ مَا تُبْلِينَا ، فَأَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ ، وَوَسِّعْ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى فُقَرَاءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ» . قَالَ: وَكَانَ إِذَا تَنَاوَلَ الطَّعَامَ يَقُولُ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ» . وَكَانَ يَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ بَيْنَ كُلِّ لُقْمَتَيْنِ ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ بَيْنَ كُلِّ خُطْوَتَيْنِ ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَفَعَ يَدَهُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ يَقُولُ: «أَطْعَمْتَ رَبِّي وَأَشْبَعْتَ ، لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فَهَنِّهِ ، أَكْثَرْتَ رَبِّي مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ ، لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فَزِدْ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Zubayr narrated to me, from Anas, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ, when food was brought to him, would say: “Glory be to You and praise; how much You give us! Glory be to You and praise; how great is the well-being You grant us! Glory be to You and praise; how excellent is the trial with which You try us! So complete Your favor upon us, and make it ample for us and for the poor of the Muslims.” He said: And when he took the food he would say: “In the name of God, at its beginning and its end.” And he would praise God between every two morsels; and the Messenger of God ﷺ would remember God between every two steps; and the Messenger of God ﷺ, when he lifted his hand from the food, would say: “You have fed, my Lord, and satisfied; to You be praise, so let it be wholesome (fa-hanni'hu); You have given abundantly of good things, my Lord; to You be praise, so increase.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 12
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‌ ‌ إِذَا انْفَتَلَ مِنْ صَلاتِهِ مَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ اللَّهُمَّ أَذْهِبْ عَنِّي الْهَمَّ وَالْحَزَنَ»
entries.isnad_en: And by his chain of transmission he said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ, when he turned away from his prayer, would wipe his face with his right hand, then say: “In the name of God, than whom there is no god, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate; O God, remove from me worry and grief.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 13
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَكْتَالَ لَهُ بِالْقَفِيزِ الأَوْفَى ، فَلْيَقُلْ: {فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ {17} وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ {18} يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَيُحْيِي الأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَكَذَلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ {19} } [الروم: 17-19] . {سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ {180} وَسَلامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ {181} وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ {182} } [الصافات: 180-182] "
entries.isnad_en: And by it he said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever wishes to be measured out [his reward] with the fullest measure (qafiz), let him say: {So glory be to God when you reach the evening and when you rise in the morning {17} and to Him be praise in the heavens and the earth, and in the evening and when you are at midday {18} He brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living, and gives life to the earth after its death; and thus you will be brought forth {19}} [al-Rum: 17–19]. {Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe {180} and peace be upon the messengers {181} and praise be to God, Lord of the worlds {182}} [al-Saffat: 180–182].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 14
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: ‌
entries.matn_ar: ‌«قَرْضُ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي عَفَافٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ مَرَّةً»
entries.isnad_en: And by it, from al-Zubayr, from Anas, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “A loan twice, in propriety ('afaf), is better than charity once.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 15
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ‌ ‌ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ اسْتَوَى قَائِمًا حَتَّى يُقِيمَ صُلْبَهُ ثُمَّ يَخِرُّ سَاجِدًا
entries.matn_en: Anas b. Malik, when he raised his head from bowing (ruku'), would stand upright until his spine was straight, then go down prostrating.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 16
entries.matn_ar: سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ‌ ‌ عَنِ الصَّوْمِ فِي السَّفَرِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ أَمْ تَرْكُهُ؟ قَالَ: «أَنْ أَصُومَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»
entries.matn_en: Anas was asked about fasting while travelling in the month of Ramadan: Is it more beloved to you, or leaving it? He said: “That I fast is more beloved to me.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 17
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: ‌
entries.matn_ar: ‌«غُسْلُ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ إِلا امْرَأَةً حَائِضًا أَوْ مَرِيضًا»
entries.isnad_en: And by it, from Anas, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “The Friday bath (ghusl) is obligatory upon every Muslim, except a menstruating woman or a sick person.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 18
entries.matn_ar: وَحَدَّثَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ السِّجِسْتَانِيُّ ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ. يَعْنِي مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ: ‌ ‌«غُسْلُ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ»
entries.matn_en: Bishr narrated to us, he said: Abu Sa'id al-Sijistani narrated, from al-Qasim, from Ibn 'Abbas, the like of that — meaning the like of the report of Anas from the Prophet ﷺ — he said: “The Friday bath is obligatory upon every one who has reached puberty (muhtalim).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 19
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ ، يَقُولُ: ‌ ‌«أَبَى اللَّهُ لِصَاحِبِ الْخُلُقِ الْمُسِيء بِالتَّوْبَةِ» . قِيلَ: وَكَيْفَ ذَلِكَ يَا أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ؟ قَالَ: «لأَنَّهُ لا يَتُوبُ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ إِلا وَقَعَ فِي ذَنْبٍ أَعْظَمَ مِنَ الَّذِي قَدْ تَابَ مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Zubayr narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: Abu l-Darda' used to say: “God has refused repentance to the one of bad character.” It was said: How is that, O Abu l-Darda'? He said: “Because he does not repent of a sin except that he falls into a sin greater than the one he repented of.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 20
entries.isnad_ar: نا الزُّبَيْرُ ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ وَقَدْ خَرَجَ الْإِمَامُ إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِلنَّاسِ: أَنْصِتُوا ، فَقَدْ لَغَا عَلَى نَفْسِه "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Zubayr narrated to us that Ibn Mas'ud said:
entries.matn_en: “On the day of Friday, when the imam has come out: if a man says to the people ‘Be silent,’ he has engaged in idle talk against himself.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 21
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ نا الزُّبَيْرُ ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ‌
entries.matn_ar: ‌«لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ ضَرَبَ الْخُدُودَ وَشَقَّ الْجُيُوبَ وَدَعَا بِدُعَاءِ أَهْلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ» سَمِعْتُ الزُّبَيْرُ ، يَقُولُ: أَدْرَكْتُ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْسَ مِنْهُمْ رَجُلٌ يَبْتَاعُ لَحْمًا بِدِرْهَمٍ.
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Zubayr narrated to us that Ibn Mas'ud said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “He is not one of us who strikes the cheeks, tears the garments, and calls with the call of the people of the Jahiliyya.” I heard al-Zubayr say: I met eighteen of the Companions of Muhammad ﷺ, none of whom would buy meat for a dirham.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 22
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ صَلاةَ الْغَدَاةِ فَلَمَّا‌ ‌ فَرَغَ مِنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ كَبَّرَ وَقَنَتَ بِهَاتَيْنِ السُّورَتَيْنِ فِي قِرَاءَةِ أُبَيٍّ ، ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ وَرَكَعَ
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Zubayr b. 'Adi narrated to me, from Tariq b. Shihab, who said:
entries.matn_en: I prayed the morning prayer behind 'Umar b. al-Khattab, and when he had finished the recitation he said the takbir and performed the qunut with these two suras, in the reading (qira'a) of Ubayy; then he said the takbir and bowed.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 23
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالإِحْسَانِ} [النحل: 90] . قَالَ: الْعَدْلُ صَلاةُ الْفَرِيضَةِ ، وَالإِحْسَانُ: قَوْلُهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ "
entries.isnad_en: And by it, from al-Zubayr, from al-Dahhak, from Ibn 'Abbas,
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Indeed God commands justice and excellence (ihsan)} [al-Nahl: 90]. He said: Justice is the obligatory prayer, and excellence is saying: There is no god but God.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 24
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌{مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْهَا} [النمل: 89] . {وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ} [ النمل: 90] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي بِالْحَسَنَةِ: التَّوْحِيدُ قَوْلُ: لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ ، وَيَعْنِي بِخَيْرٍ مِنْهَا: يَقُولُ لَهُ مِنْهَا الْجَنَّةُ ، قَالَ: وَيَعْنِي بِالسَّيِّئَةِ الشِّرْكَ ، يَقُولُ: {فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ} [النمل: 90] "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Whoever comes with a good deed will have better than it} [al-Naml: 89]. {And whoever comes with an evil deed, their faces will be cast into the Fire} [al-Naml: 90]. He said: By the good deed he means tawhid, the saying: There is no god but God; and by “better than it” he means: He says: for him from it is Paradise; he said: and by the evil deed he means polytheism (shirk); He says: {their faces will be cast into the Fire} [al-Naml: 90].

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 25
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ} [الأعراف: 156] . فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ الشِّرْكَ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {And My mercy encompasses all things} [al-A'raf: 156]. {So I shall decree it for those who guard against polytheism}.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 26
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا} [الجن: 17] . قَالَ: جَبَلٌ فِي النَّارِ زَلِقٌ كُلَّمَا صَعَدَ الْفَاجِرُ زَلِقَ فَيَهْوِي فِي النَّارِ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {He will make him enter an arduous punishment ('adhaban sa'adan)} [al-Jinn: 17]. He said: A slippery mountain in the Fire; whenever the wicked person climbs it he slips and falls into the Fire.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 27
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ} [الفرقان: 27] . قَالَ: هُوَ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ ، وَأُبَيُّ بْنُ خَلَفٍ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {And on the Day the wrongdoer will bite his hands} [al-Furqan: 27]. He said: It is 'Uqba b. Abi Mu'ayt and Ubayy b. Khalaf.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 28
entries.matn_ar: ‌{وَفَتَنَّاكَ فُتُونًا} [طه: 40] ابْتَلَيْنَاكَ ابْتِلاءً "
entries.matn_en: {And We tried you with trials (futunan)} [Taha: 40]: We tested you with a test.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 29
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{وَلَوْ تَرَى إِذِ الظَّالِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ} [سبأ: 31] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي الْمُشْرِكِينَ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {If you could only see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord} [Saba': 31]. He said: He means the polytheists.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 30
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{أَمْشَاجٍ نَبْتَلِيهِ} [الإنسان: 2] . يَعْنِي الْوَلَدَ مِنْ صُلْبِ أَبِيهِ وَصَرْفِ الأُمِّ ، خُلِقَ مِنْ سِتٍّ، ثَلاثٍ مِنْ قِبَلِ الأَبِّ: الْعَظْمُ وَالْعِرْقُ وَاللَّحْمُ ، وَثَلاثٍ مِنْ قِبَلِ الأُمِّ: الدَّمُ وَالشَّعَرُ وَالظُّفُرُ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {mingled fluids (amshaj); We test him} [al-Insan: 2]. He means the child, from the loins of his father and the sarf of the mother; he is created from six: three from the father’s side: bone, sinew ('irq), and flesh; and three from the mother’s side: blood, hair, and nail.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 31
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{بَلَى قَادِرِينَ عَلَى أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ} [القيامة: 4] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي تُرَدُّ أَصَابِعُهُ فِي كَفِّهِ حَتَّى يَصِيرَ مِثْلَ حَافِرِ الْحِمَارِ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Yes, [We are] able to restore his fingertips (banan)} [al-Qiyama: 4]. He said: He means that his fingers will be turned back into his palm until it becomes like the hoof of a donkey.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 32
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ} [الشعراء: 153] . قَالَ: مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {You are only one of the bewitched (musahharin)} [al-Shu'ara': 153]. He said: Of the created ones.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 33
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{أَزِفَتِ الآزِفَةُ} [النجم: 57] . قَامَتِ الْقِيَامَةُ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {The imminent [Hour] has drawn near} [al-Najm: 57]. The Resurrection has arisen.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 34
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{وَلا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلافٍ مَهِينٍ} [القلم: 10] . قَالَ: هُوَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {And do not obey every vile oath-swearer} [al-Qalam: 10]. He said: It is Abu Jahl.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 35
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ} [النحل: 38] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي أَبَا جَهْلٍ وَأُبَيَّ بْنَ خَلَفٍ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {And they swore by God their strongest oaths} [al-Nahl: 38]. He said: He means Abu Jahl and Ubayy b. Khalaf.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 36
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{وَالسَّابِقُونَ الأَوَّلُونَ} [التوبة: 100] . قَالَ: أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، وَعُمَرُ ، وَعُثْمَانُ ، وَعَلِيٌّ ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ ، وَعَمَّارٌ ، وَسَلْمَانُ وَبِلالٌ ، وَصُهَيْبٌ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {And the first forerunners} [al-Tawba: 100]. He said: Abu Bakr, 'Umar, 'Uthman, 'Ali, 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf, 'Ammar, Salman, Bilal, and Suhayb.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 37
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا} [المدثر: 11] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ لَهُ أَرْبَعَةُ آلافِ دِرْهَمٍ ، وَعَشْرُ بَنِينَ ، ذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ: {وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالا مَمْدُودًا {12} وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا {13} } [المدثر: 12-13] "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Leave Me with the one whom I created alone} [al-Muddaththir: 11]. He said: He means al-Walid b. al-Mughira; he said: He had four thousand dirhams and ten sons; that is His saying: {and I gave him extensive wealth {12} and sons present [with him] {13}} [al-Muddaththir: 12–13].

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 38
entries.matn_ar: قِيلَ لَهُ: "‌ ‌ مَنْ أَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَيْكَ؟ قَالَ: جَلِيسِي "
entries.matn_en: It was said to him: “Who is the most beloved of people to you? He said: My companion in sitting (jalisi).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 39
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي‌ ‌ لا أَزَالُ أَسْأَلُ: أَمُؤْمِنٌ أَنْتَ؟ فَكَيْفَ أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ: " هَلْ أَذْنَبْتَ مُنْذُ آمَنْتَ؟ قَالَ: لا . قَالَ: فَأَنْتَ مُؤْمِنٌ ، ثُمَّ تَلا: {إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا} [الحجرات: 15] "
entries.matn_en: A man came to Ibn 'Abbas and said: I keep asking: Are you a believer? — so how should I say? He said: “Have you sinned since you believed? He said: No. He said: Then you are a believer.” Then he recited: {The believers are only those who believe in God and His Messenger and then do not doubt} [al-Hujurat: 15].

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 40
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِمَاءٍ مَعِينٍ} [الملك: 30] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي مَاءَ زَمْزَمَ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Say: Have you considered: if your water were to sink [into the earth], who would bring you flowing water?} [al-Mulk: 30]. He said: He means the water of Zamzam.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 41
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ {219} فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ} [البقرة: 219-220] . قَالَ: يَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ، فَيَقُولُونَ: هِيَ دَارُ بَلاءٍ ، ثُمَّ هِيَ دَارُ شَقَاءٍ ، ثُمَّ هِيَ دَارُ زَوَالٍ ، وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي الآخِرَةِ ، فَيَقُولُونَ: هِيَ دَارُ جَزَاءٍ ، ثُمَّ هِيَ دَارُ نَعِيمٍ ، ثُمَّ هِيَ دَارُ بَقَاءٍ ، فَيَعْمَلُونَ لِلآخِرَةِ ، وَيَدَعُونَ الدُّنْيَا "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {so that you may reflect {219} on this world and the Hereafter} [al-Baqara: 219–220]. He said: They reflect on this world and say: It is an abode of trial, then it is an abode of misery, then it is an abode of passing away; and they reflect on the Hereafter and say: It is an abode of recompense, then it is an abode of bliss, then it is an abode of permanence; so they work for the Hereafter and leave this world.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 42
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ} [التحريم: 6] . قَالَ: يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ فَيَعْمَلُ تِلْكَ الأَعْمَالَ الصَّالِحَةَ ، يُصَلِّي فَيُصَلُّونَ ، وَيَصُومُ فَيَصُومُونَ ، وَيَتَصَدَّقُ فَيَتَصَدَّقُونَ ، فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ: {قُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ} [التحريم: 6] "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {O you who believe, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones} [al-Tahrim: 6]. He said: The righteous servant is among a household and does those righteous deeds; he prays and they pray, he fasts and they fast, he gives charity and they give charity; that is His saying: {protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones} [al-Tahrim: 6].

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 43
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنْفِقُوا خَيْرًا لأَنْفُسِكُمْ} [التغابن: 16] . يَعْنِي أَنْفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْتُكُمْ حَيْثُ أَمَرْتُكُمْ فِي الصِّلَةِ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ، يَعْنِي: {وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ} [التغابن: 16] . قَالَ: مَنْ أَدَّى زَكَاةَ مَالِهِ فَقَدْ وُقِيَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {So fear God as much as you are able, and listen and obey, and spend; it is better for yourselves} [al-Taghabun: 16]. He means: spend from what I have provided you, where I commanded you: on kinship ties, the poor, the wayfarer, and in the way of God; he means: {and whoever is protected from the stinginess of his own soul} [al-Taghabun: 16]. He said: Whoever pays the zakat on his wealth has been protected from the stinginess of his soul.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 44
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ} [التكاثر: 8] . قَالَ: الأَمْنُ وَصِحَّةُ الْجِسْمِ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Then, on that Day, you will surely be asked about the bounty (na'im)} [al-Takathur: 8]. He said: Security and bodily health.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 45
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ} [الحج: 61] . قَالَ: هُوَ أَخَذَ اللَّيْلَ مِنَ النَّهَارِ ، وَأَخَذَ النَّهَارَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {He causes the night to enter into the day and causes the day to enter into the night} [al-Hajj: 61]. He said: He takes the night from the day, and takes the day from the night.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 46
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ} [يونس: 31] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي النُّطْفَةَ ، يُخْرِجُهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَهِيَ مَيْتَةٌ ، ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُهُ اللَّهُ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {He brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living} [Yunus: 31]. He said: He means the sperm-drop (nutfa); God brings it forth from the living while it is dead, then God brings it forth

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 47
entries.matn_ar: ‌{أَيَّامٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ} [الحج: 28] . قَالَ: هِيَ أَيَّامُ الْعَشْرِ أَوَّلَ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ "
entries.matn_en: {known days (ayyam ma'lumat)} [al-Hajj: 28]. He said: They are the days of the ten, the beginning of Dhu l-Hijja.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 48
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{أَيَّامًا مَعْدُودَاتٍ} [البقرة: 184] . قَالَ: هُنَّ أَيَّامُ التَّشْرِيقِ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {a limited number of days (ayyaman ma'dudat)} [al-Baqara: 184]. He said: They are the days of tashriq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 49
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{ثَلاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي الْحَجِّ} [البقرة: 196] . قَالَ: قَبْلَ التَّرْوِيَةِ بِيَوْمٍ ، وَيَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ ، وَيَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {three days during the pilgrimage} [al-Baqara: 196]. He said: A day before the Day of Tarwiya, the Day of Tarwiya, and the Day of 'Arafa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 50
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{أَيَّامٍ نَحِسَاتٍ} [فصلت: 16] . قَالَ: آخِرُ شَوَّالٍ مِنَ الأَرْبَعَاءِ إِلَى الأَرْبَعَاءِ ، وَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ: {سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا} [الحاقة: 7] "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {ill-omened days (ayyam nahisat)} [Fussilat: 16]. He said: The end of Shawwal, from Wednesday to Wednesday; and that is His saying: {seven nights and eight days in succession} [al-Haqqa: 7].

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 51
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ‌ ‌ الشَّيْطَانَ فَقِيهٌ غَيْرُ رَشِيدٍ»
entries.matn_en: he said: “Indeed, Satan is a jurist (faqih), but not rightly guided.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 52
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا} [يونس: 58] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ: الْقُرْآنُ ، وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا يَعْنِي: مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم. " ثُمَّ تَلا {وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ} [الأنبياء: 107]
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Say: In the bounty of God and in His mercy — in that let them rejoice} [Yunus: 58]. He said: He means by “the bounty of God”: the Qur'an; and “in His mercy let them rejoice” means: Muhammad ﷺ. Then he recited: {And We did not send you except as a mercy to the worlds} [al-Anbiya': 107].

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 53
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{فَاسْأَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا} [الفرقان: 59] . يَعْنِي: سَلْ بِهِ جِبْرِيلَ عليه السلام "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {so ask about Him one who is well-informed} [al-Furqan: 59]. He means: ask Jibril ﵇ about Him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 54
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُمْ بُنْيَانٌ مَرْصُوصٌ} [الصف: 4] . مَنْ هَؤُلاءِ. قَالَ: حَمْزَةُ أَسَدُ اللَّهِ وَأَسَدُ رَسُولِهِ ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ، وَعُبَيْدَةُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ ، وَالْمِقْدَادُ بْنُ الأَسْوَدِ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Indeed God loves those who fight in His cause in a row, as though they were a solid structure} [al-Saff: 4]. Who are these? He said: Hamza, the lion of God and the lion of His Messenger; 'Ali b. Abi Talib; 'Ubayda b. al-Harith; and al-Miqdad b. al-Aswad.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 55
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا} [الجن: 4] . قَالَ: هُوَ إِبْلِيسُ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {our foolish one used to say an outrageous falsehood about God} [al-Jinn: 4]. He said: It is Iblis.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 56
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{مَذْمُومًا مَدْحُورًا} [الإسراء: 18] . قَالَ: الْمَذْمُومُ: هُوَ الْمَلْعُونُ ، وَالْمَدْحُورُ: الْمَنْفِيُّ الْمَطْرُودُ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {disgraced and driven away (madhmuman madhuran)} [al-Isra': 18]. He said: The madhmum is the accursed one, and the madhur is the banished, the expelled.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 57
entries.matn_ar: ‌{زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ} [هود: 106] . قَالَ: الزَّفِيرُ أَنِينُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ، وَالشَّهِيقُ النَّفَسُ الْعَالِي "
entries.matn_en: {sighing and wailing (zafir wa-shahiq)} [Hud: 106]. He said: The zafir is the groaning of the people of the Fire, and the shahiq is the labored breath.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 58
entries.isnad_ar: وَعَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ‌ ‌ عَنِ الأَحْقَافِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «جِبَالٌ فِي الشَّامِ مِنْ رِمَالٍ ، يُقَالُ لَهُ» . فَسَكَتَ
entries.matn_en: that he was asked about al-Ahqaf; he said: “Mountains of sand in Syria; it is said of it —” and he fell silent.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 59
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَغْفِرُوا لِلَّذِينَ لا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ} [الجاثية: 14] . قَالَ: كَانَ بَيْنَ يَهُودِيٍّ وَبَيْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ كَلامٌ فِي التَّوْحِيدِ ، فَأَغْلَظَ لَهُ عُمَرُ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {Say to those who believe that they should forgive those who do not hope for the days of God} [al-Jathiya: 14]. He said: There was an exchange between a Jew and 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵀ about tawhid, and 'Umar spoke harshly to him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 60
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَا الثَّقَلانِ} [الرحمن: 31] . قَالَ: الثَّقَلانِ: الْجِنُّ وَالإِنْسُ. وَقَوْلُهُ {سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ} [ الرحمن: 31] . وَعِيدٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {We shall attend to you, O you two weighty ones (al-thaqalan)} [al-Rahman: 31]. He said: The two weighty ones are the jinn and humankind. And His saying {We shall attend to you} [al-Rahman: 31] is a threat from God.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 61
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{وَبَشِّرِ الْمُخْبِتِينَ {34} الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَهُمْ وَالْمُقِيمِي الصَّلاةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ {35} } [الحج: 34-35] . قَالَ: أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَعَلِيٌّ وَسَلْمَانُ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {And give good tidings to the humble {34} those who, when God is mentioned, their hearts tremble, and the patient over what afflicts them, and those who establish prayer, and who spend from what We have provided them {35}} [al-Hajj: 34–35]. He said: Abu Bakr, 'Umar, 'Ali, and Salman.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 62
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: " ‌ ‌{وَلا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا} [الكهف: 28] . قَالَ: يَعْنِي أَبَا جَهْلٍ "
entries.matn_en: regarding His saying: {and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance} [al-Kahf: 28]. He said: He means Abu Jahl.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 63
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ أنبا الْحَجَّاجُ ، ثنا النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ السَّلامِ ، ثنا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التُّسْتَرِيُّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ ،
entries.matn_ar: قِيلَ لَهُ: أَلا تُجَاهِدُ؟ فَسَكَتَ ، فَسَأَلَهُ ، فَسَكَتَ ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: "‌ ‌ بُنِيَ الْإِسْلامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: عَلَى شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاةِ ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ ، وَحِجِّ الْبَيْتِ ، وَصَوْمِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ "
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Hajjaj informed us: al-Nu'man b. 'Abd al-Salam narrated to us: Yazid b. Ibrahim al-Tustari narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Ubayd b. 'Umayr:
entries.matn_en: it was said to him: Will you not wage jihad? He fell silent; he asked him, and he fell silent. He said: Then Ibn 'Umar said: “Islam is built upon five: the testimony that there is no god but God, the establishment of prayer, the payment of zakat, the pilgrimage to the House, and the fasting of the month of Ramadan.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 64
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ ثنا الْحَجَّاجُ ، ثنا النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ السَّلامِ ، ثنا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ السَّبِيعِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ الطَّائِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَاتَ أَخٌ لِي فَأَوْصَى إِلَيَّ ، وَأَوْصَى بِبَعْضِ مَالِهِ ، قَالَ: فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ ، أَسْأَلُهُ أَنْ أَجْعَلَ فِي الْمَسَاكِينِ وَالْفُقَرَاءِ ، قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: أَمَا لَوْ كُنْتُ أَنَا لَجَعَلْتُهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عز وجل ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ‌ ‌«مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَعْتِقُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي يُهْدِي بَعْدَ مَا شَبِعَ» . وَالصَّوَابُ عَنْ أَبِي حَبِيبَةَ الطَّائِيِّ ، وَلَكِنْ كَذَا قَالَ الشَّيْخُ. يَعْنِي الْحَجَّاجَ
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Hajjaj narrated to us: al-Nu'man b. 'Abd al-Salam narrated to us: Sufyan al-Thawri narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Sabi'i, from Abu Habib al-Ta'i, who said:
entries.matn_en: A brother of mine died and appointed me executor and bequeathed part of his property. He said: So I came to Abu l-Darda', asking him whether I should put it toward the poor and the needy. Abu l-Darda' said: Were I in your place, I would put it in the way of God, Mighty and Majestic. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “The likeness of one who frees [a slave] at the time of death is like that of one who gives a gift after he has eaten his fill.” And the correct [form] is from Abu Habiba al-Ta'i, but thus the shaykh said — meaning al-Hajjaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 65
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ ثنا الْحَجَّاجُ ، ثنا النُّعْمَانُ ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ‌
entries.matn_ar: ‌«سَلُوا اللَّهَ لِيَ الْوَسِيلَةَ ، لا يَسْأَلُهَا لِي مُؤْمِنٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا إِلا كُنْتُ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا أَوْ شَهِيدًا» وَبِهِ ثنا النُّعْمَانُ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ ، قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيَّ صَلَّى فِي مَرَضِهِ عَلَى جَنْبِهِ الأَيْمَنِ. وَبِهِ ثنا مِسْعَرُ بْنُ كِدَامٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ابْنِ الأَصْبَهَانِيُّ ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيَّ يُسِرُّ رَجُلا يَدْعُو قَائِمًا بَعْدَ مَا انْفَتَلَ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ.
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Hajjaj narrated to us: al-Nu'man narrated to us, from Musa b. 'Ubayda, from Muhammad b. 'Amr b. 'Ata', from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Ask God for the wasila for me; no believer asks it for me in this world but that I shall be an intercessor or a witness for him on the Day of Resurrection.” And by it al-Nu'man narrated to us, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from Abu l-Haytham, who said: I saw Ibrahim al-Nakha'i pray during his illness on his right side. And by it Mis'ar b. Kidam narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Asbahani, that he saw Abu 'Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami speaking privately to a man, supplicating while standing, after he had turned away from the prayer.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 66
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ ثنا النُّعْمَانُ ، ثنا شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ النَّخَعِيُّ ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ الثَّقَفِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي لَيْلَى الْكِنْدِيِّ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفْلَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَتَانَا مُصَدِّقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهِ وَقَرَأْتُ فِي عَهْدِهِ: ‌ ‌«أَنْ لا تَجْمَعَ بَيْنَ مُتَفَرِّقٍ، وَلا تُفَرِّقَ بَيْنَ الْمُجْتَمِعِ» . وَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ بِنَاقَةٍ عَظِيمَةٍ مُلَمْلَمَةٍ ، فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْخُذَهَا ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ بِدُونِهَا فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْخُذَهَا ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ بِدُونِهَا فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْخُذَهَا ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ بِدُونِهَا فَأَخَذَهَا ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَيُّ سَمَاءٍ تُظِلُّنِي ، وَأَيُّ أَرْضٍ تُقِلُّنِي ، إِنْ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أَخَذْتُ خِيَارَ إِبِلِ رَجُلٍ مُسْلِمٍ
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Nu'man narrated to us: Sharik b. 'Abd Allah al-Nakha'i narrated to us, from 'Uthman al-Thaqafi, from Abu Layla al-Kindi, from Suwayd b. Ghafala, who said:
entries.matn_en: The alms collector (musaddiq) of the Messenger of God ﷺ came to us; I took him by the hand and read in his covenant: “Do not combine what is separate, and do not separate what is combined.” A man came to him with a great, plump she-camel, and he refused to take it; then he brought him one lesser than it, and he refused to take it; then he brought him one lesser than it, and he refused to take it; then he brought him one lesser than it, and he took it. Then he said: What sky will shade me, and what earth will bear me, if I come to the Messenger of God ﷺ having taken the best of the camels of a Muslim man?

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 67
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ ، ثنا بِشْرٌ ، ثنا الزُّبَيْرُ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: ‌ ‌«عَجِبْتُ لِلتَّاجِرِ كَيْفَ يَسْلَمُ إِذَا بَاعَ أَطْرَى وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى ذَمَّ ، مَا رَجُلٌ أَكْسَبُ مِنْ رَجُلٍ ، وَلا عَامٌ بِأَكْثَرَ مَطَرًا مِنْ عَامٍ ، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ، وَيَصْرِفُ الْمَطَرَ حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Hajjaj narrated to us: Bishr narrated to us:
entries.matn_en: al-Zubayr narrated to us, saying: Ibn Mas'ud said: “I am amazed at the merchant: how does he remain safe, when if he sells he extols [his goods] and if he buys he disparages? No man earns more than another man, and no year has more rain than another year; rather, God provides for whom He wills, and directs the rain where He wills.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 68
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: ‌ ‌«أَتَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ إِذَا نَهَاكَ ، وَإِذَا لَمْ يَنْهَكَ فَلَسْتَ تَقْرَؤُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And by it, from al-Zubayr, from al-Ma'rur b. Suwayd, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab said: “Do you recite the Qur'an when it restrains you? And when it does not restrain you, you are not [truly] reciting it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 69
entries.matn_ar: سُئِلَ حُذَيْفَةُ‌ ‌ عَنِ النِّفَاقِ ، فَقَالَ: «مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فِي مَكَانٍ لا يَرَاهُ أَحَدٌ إِلا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَقَدْ بَرِئَ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ» . ثُمَّ قَالَ: " إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقَ مَنْ إِذَا خَلا لا يُصَلِّي ، وَكَذَلِكَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ: {وَإِذَا خَلَوْا إِلَى شَيَاطِينِهِمْ قَالُوا إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِءُونَ} [البقرة: 14] "
entries.isnad_en: And by it, from al-Zubayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: Hudhayfa was asked about hypocrisy (nifaq), and he said: “Whoever performs ablution in a place where no one sees him but God, then prays two rak'as, has been cleared of hypocrisy.” Then he said: “The hypocrite is one who, when alone, does not pray; and likewise is the saying of God: {And when they are alone with their devils, they say: We are with you; we are only mocking} [al-Baqara: 14].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 70
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: ‌ ‌«إِنَّا أُوتِينَا الإِيمَانَ ، ثُمَّ أُوتِينَا الْقُرْآنَ ، وَسَيَجِيءُ بَعْدَكُمْ أَقْوَامٌ يُؤْتَوْنَ الْقُرْآنَ وَلا يُؤْتَوْنَ الإِيمَانَ»
entries.matn_en: Ibn Mas'ud said: “We were given faith, then we were given the Qur'an; and after you there will come peoples who are given the Qur'an but are not given faith.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 71
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ ثنا الزُّبَيْرُ ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ‌
entries.matn_ar: ‌«الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ ، وَالْفِضَّةُ بِالْفِضَّةِ ، وَالْبُرُّ بِالْبُرِّ ، وَالشَّعِيرُ بِالشَّعِيرِ ، وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ ، وَالزَّبِيبُ بِالزَّبِيبِ ، وَالْمِلْحُ بِالْمِلْحِ ، مِثْلا بِمِثْلٍ، يَدًا بِيَدٍ ، فَمَنْ زَادَ أَوِ اسْتَزَادَ فَقَدْ أَرْبَى»
entries.isnad_en: And by it al-Zubayr narrated to us, from al-Ma'rur, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Gold for gold, silver for silver, wheat for wheat, barley for barley, dates for dates, raisins for raisins, salt for salt — like for like, hand to hand; whoever gives more or asks for more has practised usury (riba).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 72
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ الأَعْوَرِ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عليه السلام: "‌ ‌ ثَلاثٌ بَعْدَهُنَّ ثَلاثٌ: وَأْدُ الْبَنَاتِ ، وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَاتِ ، وَمَنْعُ وَهَاتِ . وَبَعْدَهُنَّ ثَلاثٌ: إِضَاعَةُ الْمَالِ ، وَإِلْحَافُ السُّؤَالِ ، وَقِيلَ وَقَالَ "
entries.isnad_en: And by it, from al-Zubayr, from al-Harith al-A'war al-Hamdani, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali ﵇ said: “Three, after which come three: burying daughters alive, disobedience to mothers, and withholding and demanding (man' wa-hat). And after them, three: squandering wealth, importunate begging, and idle talk (qila wa-qala).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 73
entries.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ ثَلاثٌ مِنْ رَأْسِ التَّوَاضُعِ: أَنْ تَبْدَأَ بِالسَّلامِ مَنْ لَقِيتَ ، وَتَرْضَى بِالدُّونِ مِنْ شَرَفِ الْمَجْلِسِ ، وَتَكْرَهُ الرِّيَاءَ وَالسُّمْعَةَ بِالْبِرِّ "
entries.isnad_en: And by it, from 'Ali, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Three things are at the head of humility: that you greet first whomever you meet, that you are content with a lower seat than the place of honor in the gathering, and that you dislike ostentation (riya') and showing off (sum'a) in righteous deeds.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 74
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ عَلِيٌّ عليه السلام ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى الرَّحْبَةِ ، وَقَالَ: " أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ‌ ‌ خَمْسٌ احْفَظُوهُنَّ عَنِّي ، فَلَوْ رَكِبْتُمُ الْمَطِيَّ لأَنْضَيْتُمُوهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ لا تَجِدُوا مَنْ يُخْبِرُكُمْ بِهِنَّ: أَلا لا يَخَافَنَّ الْعَبْدُ إِلا ذَنْبَهُ ، وَلا يَرْجُوَنَّ إِلا رَبَّهُ ، أَلا فَلا يَسْتَحِيَنَّ الْعَبْدُ إِذَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنْ يَتَعَلَّمَ ، وَلا يَسْتَحِيَنَّ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَمَّا لا يَعْلَمُ أَنْ يَقُولَ: اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ؛ فَإِنَّ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ أَنْ تَقُولَ لِمَا لا تَعْلَمُ: اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ، أَلا وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ الصَّبْرَ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الْجَسَدِ ، فَإِذَا قُطِعَ الرَّأْسُ ذَهَبَ الْجَسَدُ ، وَلا إِيمَانَ لِمَنْ لا صَبْرَ لَهُ "
entries.matn_en: 'Ali ﵇ went out one night to the Rahba and said: “O people, five [things]; preserve them from me, for if you were to ride riding-beasts you would wear them out before you found anyone to tell you of them: Let the servant fear nothing but his sin, and hope for nothing but his Lord. And let the servant not be shy, when he does not know, to learn; and let him not be shy, when asked about what he does not know, to say: God knows best; for part of knowledge is that you say of what you do not know: God knows best. And know that patience, in relation to faith, is in the position of the head in relation to the body; when the head is cut off, the body is gone; and there is no faith for one who has no patience.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 75
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ: وَكَانَ عَلِيٌّ عليه السلام ، يَقُولُ: ‌ ‌«لَطَلَبُ الْمَالِ وَالْمُرُوءَةِ أَسْرَعُ فِي خَرَابِ دِينِ الرَّجُلِ مِنْ ذِئْبَيْنِ ضَارِيَيْنِ بَاتَا فِي حَظِيرَةِ غَنَمٍ ، فَمَاذَا أَبْقَيَا حِينَ أَصْبَحَا؟»
entries.matn_en: Al-Zubayr said: 'Ali ﵇ used to say: “The pursuit of wealth and reputation (muru'a) hastens the ruin of a man’s religion more than two ravening wolves that spend the night in a sheepfold: what do they leave when morning comes?”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 76
entries.matn_ar: أَتَيْتُ عَلِيًّا عليه السلام ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ،‌ ‌ مَا الإِيمَانُ؟ فَسِّرْهُ لِي ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ: " يَا حَارِثُ إِنَّ الإِيمَانَ شَيْءٌ عَلَى أَرْبَعِ دَعَائِمَ: عَلَى الصَّبْرِ ، وَالْيَقِينِ ، وَالْعَدْلِ ، وَالْجِهَادِ ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: فَعَلامَ بُنِيَ الصَّبْرُ؟ قَالَ: بُنِيَ الصَّبْرُ عَلَى أَرْبَعِ شُعَبٍ: عَلَى الشَّوْقِ ، وَالشَّفَقِ ، وَالزُّهْدِ ، وَالتَّرَقُّبِ ، فَمَنِ اشْتَاقَ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ سَلا عَنِ الشَّهَوَاتِ ، وَمَنْ أَشْفَقَ مِنَ النَّارِ رَجَعَ عَنِ الْحُرُمَاتِ ، وَمَنْ زَهِدَ فِي الدُّنْيَا تَهَاوَنَ بِالْمُصِيبَاتِ ، وَمَنْ رَاقَبَ الْمَوْتَ سَارَعَ إِلَى الْخَيْرَاتِ. قَالَ: قُلْتُ: فَعَلامَ بُنِيَ الْيَقِينُ؟ قَالَ: عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ شُعَبٍ: عَلَى تَبْصِرَةِ الْفِطْنَةِ ، وَتِلاوَةِ الْحِكْمَةِ ، وَمَوْعِظَةِ الْعِبْرَةِ ، وَسُنَّةِ الأَوَّلِينَ ، قَالَ: فَمَنْ أَبْصَرَ الْفِطْنَةَ تَلا الْحِكْمَةَ ، وَمَنْ تَلا الْحِكْمَةَ عَرَفَ الْعِبْرَةَ ، وَمَنْ عَرَفَ الْعِبْرَةَ فَكَأَنَّمَا كَانَ فِي الأَوَّلِينَ ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: فَعَلامَ بُنِيَ الْعَدْلُ؟ قَالَ: بُنِيَ الْعَدْلُ عَلَى أَرْبَعِ شُعَبٍ: عَلَى غَايَةِ الْفَهْمِ ، وَرَوْضَةِ الْحِلْمِ ، وَزَهْرَةِ الْعِلْمِ ، وَشَرَائِعِ الْحِكْمَةِ ، فَمَنْ فَهِمَ فَسَّرَ الْعِلْمَ ، وَمَنْ فَسَّرَ الْعِلْمَ عَرَفَ شَرَائِعَ الْحِكْمَةِ ، وَمَنْ عَرَفَ شَرَائِعَ الْحِكْمَةِ حَلُمَ ، وَمَنْ حَلُمَ أَبْصَرَ أَمْرَهُ وَعَاشَ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَمِيدًا " قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: فَعَلامَ بُنِيَ الْجِهَادُ؟ قَالَ: بَخٍ بَخٍ ، سَيِّدُ أَعْمَالِكُمْ وَأَسَاسُ دِينِكُمْ وَقَوَامُ أُمُورِكُمْ ، فَالْجِهَادُ عَلَى أَرْبَعِ شُعَبٍ: لَيْسَ عَلَى ضَرْبٍ بِالسَّيْفِ وَحْدَهُ ، وَلَكِنْ أَمْرٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ، وَنَهْيٌ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ، وَالصَّبْرُ فِي الْمَوَاطِنِ ، وَشَنَآنُ الْفَاسِقِينَ. قَالَ: فَمَنْ أَمَرَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ شَدَّ ظَهْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِ ، وَمَنْ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ الْمُنَافِقِ ، وَمَنْ صَبَرَ فِي الْمَوَاطِنِ قَضَى الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ ، وَمَنْ غَضِبَ لِلَّهِ وَشَنَأَ الْفَاسِقِينَ غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عز وجل لَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: And by it, from al-Harith, who said:
entries.matn_en: I came to 'Ali ﵇ and said: O Commander of the Believers, what is faith? Explain it to me. He said: “O Harith, faith is a thing on four pillars: on patience, certainty, justice, and jihad. He said: I said: On what is patience built? He said: Patience is built on four branches: on longing (shawq), apprehension (shafaq), asceticism (zuhd), and anticipation (tarqqub); so whoever longs for Paradise turns away from base desires, and whoever is apprehensive of the Fire turns back from the forbidden things, and whoever is ascetic in this world treats afflictions lightly, and whoever keeps watch for death hastens to good deeds. He said: I said: On what is certainty built? He said: On four branches: on the insight of sagacity, the recitation of wisdom, the admonition of lessons, and the practice (sunna) of the ancients. He said: Whoever has insight into sagacity recites wisdom, and whoever recites wisdom knows the lesson, and whoever knows the lesson is as though he were among the ancients. He said: I said: On what is justice built? He said: Justice is built on four branches: on the utmost of understanding, the garden of forbearance, the flower of knowledge, and the paths (shara'i') of wisdom; so whoever understands explains knowledge, and whoever explains knowledge knows the paths of wisdom, and whoever knows the paths of wisdom is forbearing, and whoever is forbearing sees his affair clearly and lives in this world praised.” He said: I said: On what is jihad built? He said: “Excellent, excellent! It is the master of your deeds, the foundation of your religion, and the support of your affairs. Jihad is on four branches: not merely striking with the sword, but commanding the right (ma'ruf), forbidding the wrong (munkar), patience in the battle stations, and detestation of the transgressors. He said: Whoever commands the right strengthens the back of the believer; whoever forbids the wrong has the hypocrite’s nose rubbed in the dust; whoever is patient in the stations has fulfilled what is upon him; and whoever becomes angry for God and detests the transgressors, God, Mighty and Majestic, becomes angry for him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 77
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْرُ ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ‌ ‌ يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاةِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ . وَبِهِ نا الْحَجَّاجُ ، نا بِشْرٌ ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النُّجُودِ ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: And by it he said: Al-Zubayr narrated to me, from al-Ma'rur b. Suwayd, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw 'Umar b. al-Khattab perform ablution for the prayer twice each. And by it al-Hajjaj informed us: Bishr informed us, from 'Asim b. Abi l-Najud, from al-Ma'rur b. Suwayd, from 'Umar, the like of that.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 78
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ نا بِشْرٌ ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ دَخَلَ عَلَى عُمَرَ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ ، فَقَالَ: " أَبْشِرْ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ،‌ ‌ أَبْشِرْ بِالْجَنَّةِ ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: مَهْ. قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: بَلَى ، أَسْلَمْتَ حِينَ كَفَرُوا ، وَجَاهَدْتَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ خَذَلُوهُ ، وَتُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَنْكَ رَاضٍ " نا بِشْرٌ ، قَالَ: تَلا الزُّبَيْرُ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ: {وَأُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ هَذَا الْقُرْءَانُ لأُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهِ وَمَنْ بَلَغَ} [الأنعام: 19] . مَنْ بَلَغَهُ الْقُرْآنُ ، فَكَأَنَّمَا هُوَ قَدْ عَايَنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّبِيِّينَ قَبْلَهُ ، ثُمَّ تَلا: {وَأُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ هَذَا الْقُرْءَانُ لأُنْذِرَكُمْ بِهِ وَمَنْ بَلَغَ} [الأنعام: 19] حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْرُ ، قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ، قَالَ: أَرَأَيْتَ الْإِمَامَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَيَخْطُبُ جَالِسًا أَوْ قَائِمًا؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ: كَيْفَ تَقْرَأُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: {وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انْفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ} [الجمعة: 11] . قَائِمًا أَوْ قَاعِدًا؟ قَالَ: بَلْ أَقْرَؤُهَا: {قَائِمًا} [الجمعة: 11] . قَالَ: فَهُوَ ذَلِكَ. عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ أُمِّي إِذَا أَرَادَتِ الْوُضُوءَ أَخَذَتِ الْمَاءَ بِيَدِهَا ، ثُمَّ صَبَّتْهُ ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَتْ وَجْهَهَا بِكَفَّيْهَا ، قَالَ: فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ النَّخَعِيُّ ، ثُمّ أَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ الثَّانِيَةِ ، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ ، ثُمَّ أَعَادَ الثَّالِثَةَ ، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ، ثُمَّ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: وَهَلِ الْوُضُوءُ إِلا هَكَذَا؟ مَا عَهِدْنَاهُمْ يَلْطِمُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ بِالْمَاءِ.
entries.isnad_en: And by it Bishr informed us, from al-Zubayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: It reached me that 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas entered upon 'Umar at his death and said: “Rejoice, O Commander of the Believers; rejoice in Paradise. 'Umar said: Enough! Ibn 'Abbas said: Indeed: you accepted Islam when they disbelieved, and you waged jihad alongside the Messenger of God ﷺ when they abandoned him, and the Messenger of God ﷺ died while he was pleased with you.” Bishr informed us, saying: al-Zubayr recited this verse: {And this Qur'an was revealed to me that I may warn you by it and whomever it reaches} [al-An'am: 19]. Whomever the Qur'an reaches, it is as though he had seen the Messenger of God ﷺ and the prophets before him; then he recited: {And this Qur'an was revealed to me that I may warn you by it and whomever it reaches} [al-An'am: 19]. Al-Zubayr narrated to me, saying: A man came to Ibrahim al-Nakha'i and said: What is your opinion: does the imam on the day of Friday give the sermon sitting or standing? He said to him: How do you read in the Book of God: {And when they see trade or amusement, they scatter to it and leave you} [al-Jumu'a: 11] — standing or sitting? He said: I read it: {standing} [al-Jumu'a: 11]. He said: Then that is it. From al-Zubayr, who said: A man came to Ibrahim al-Nakha'i and said: When my mother wants to perform ablution, she takes the water in her hand, then pours it out, then wipes her face with her palms. He said: Ibrahim al-Nakha'i turned away from him; then he repeated it to him a second time, and he turned away from him; then he repeated it a third time, and Ibrahim turned away from him; then Ibrahim said: Is ablution anything but this? We never knew them to slap their faces with water.

entries.citation: Copy of al-Zubayr ibn ʿAdī · p. 79
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، فَقَالَ: " إِنِّي رَاعٍ إِبِلَ أَهْلِي ، فَأَعْزُبُ عَنْهُمُ اللَّيْلَتَيْنِ وَالثَّلاثَ ، فَيَمُرُّ بِي الْمَارُّ فَيَسْتَسْقِي ، أَفَأَسْقِيهِ؟ قَالَ: لا. قَالَ: قَدْ ذَهَبَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: رُدَّهُ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: كَيْفَ قُلْتَ؟ قَالَ: قُلْتُ:‌ ‌ إِنِّي رَاعٍ إِبِلَ أَهْلِي فَأَعْزُبُ عَنْهُمُ اللَّيْلَتَيْنِ وَالثَّلاثَ ، فَيَمُرُّ بِي الْمَارُّ فَيَسْتَسْقِي ، أَفَأَسْقِيهِ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ ، قَدْرَ مَا يُبَلِّغُهُ إِلَيَّ غَيْرُكَ ، ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذِنْ مَوَالِيكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Zubayr narrated to me, from Masruq, who said:
entries.matn_en: A Bedouin came to Ibn 'Abbas and said: “I herd my family’s camels, and I am away from them for two nights or three; and a passer-by passes me and asks for water; shall I give him to drink? He said: No. He said: The Bedouin went off; so Ibn 'Abbas said: Bring him back. He said to him: What did you say? He said: I said: I herd my family’s camels and I am away from them for two nights or three, and a passer-by passes me and asks for water; shall I give him to drink? He said: Yes, as much as will carry him on to someone other than you; then ask permission of your masters.”

entries.matn_ar: كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَقُولُ: ‌ ‌«دِيَةُ الْيَهُودِيِّ وَالنَّصْرَانِيِّ أَرْبَعَةُ آلافٍ ، وَالْمَجُوسِيِّ ثَمَانُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ»
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab used to say: “The blood-money (diya) of the Jew and the Christian is four thousand, and of the Zoroastrian eight hundred dirhams.”
